mobbin:94df2baf-9653-4a11-ba8d-5131225a4.summary: From an empty Lists page, the user names a list with description and cover photo, searches the store catalog to pick items, and lands on a saved list detail ready to edit or share.
steps: Named list detail with Edit items
steal: Empty Lists: dual CTAs (header + empty-state link) so create is never buried.
Add-items modal: Current list vs Buy it again tabs; empty Buy it again offers Browse categories.
Search modal: popular-search tiles with thumbnails before typing; multi-select checkmarks then Done.
List detail: lock + share on the named list header; description under title as setup notes analog.
avoid: Required cover-photo picker before adding items — extra ceremony for a tech prep sheet.
mobbin:94df2baf-9653-4a11-ba8d-5131225a4.fit: Extends today's free-text Equipment & Supplies toward catalog pick + named list with notes; stock/checkout stays in Inventory, matching Baseline.
